implementation.report_only_control: AESTRA_EXAMPLE_REPORT_FLASHES=0 is allowed only in image lane; sets TransientLightSettings.max_lumens=0 before playback, preserving enabled/authored_bindings/caps/event admission and smoke simulation. Omitted/1 retains normal lighting.
implementation.per_capture_observation: Main-world representative pooled PointLight intensity maximum, active and accepted counts at screenshot request. This is not the exact displayed frame or a GPU fence.
implementation.new_rejections: Report budget_dropped/expired/invalid/disabled for representative realization; does not trace every earlier source/capture/transport/binding stage.
implementation.selected_lights: Current saved show is representative-only; policy disables selected lighting. No selected outputs injected to make this control pass.

qualification.scope: Async nominal-time live screenshots/aggregate readbacks, not exact frame pairs or every-frame/isolated older-particle proof. ROI is descriptive, not a photographic or exact-pixel pass threshold. This is an image/capacity lane; no cost acceptance from HUD/intervals.
qualification.pending_pipelines: All ten reports retain one global-cache pending update. The counter does not identify the pipeline/cause. No zero-late-pipeline claim for this image lane.

assessment.image_scope: Forward asynchronous nominal-time captures, not exact pairs. Fixed ROI is descriptive, not an exact-pixel or isolated light-family acceptance threshold. Quiet 22s is the no-active-flash comparison. Selected lighting is absent.

tests_added: Mute parsing is explicit and image-only; invalid values/cost-lane mute rejected.

validation.clippy: cargo clippy -p aestra-bevy --example fireworks --features fireworks-audio --locked --offline -- -D warnings; passed (environmental incremental hard-link fallback notices).
validation.powershell: Runner parsed through PowerShell Language.Parser and exercised for all nine cases plus isolated repeat.
validation.native_checker: Counter/lifecycle/capacity gate passes; strict flash accounting intentionally exits1 for retained unexplained medium failure. Low policy reductions remain recorded separately. Successful repeat does not erase initial failure.
validation.not_rerun: No full workspace or renderer test suite rerun for this report-only slice; predecessor tests remain separately scoped.

reproduce.check: python benchmarks/fireworks/check-star-path-review.py MATRIX-DIRECTORY REPEAT-DIRECTORY (requires Pillow/NumPy); writes assessment.json; returns1 for unaccounted flashes or smoke/safety failures.

remaining: Trace representative source capture/readback/binding/expiry versus encoded owner time under load; diagnose initial missing flash without treating lag correlation as proven cause.
Preserve bounded async transport and cap telemetry; do not raise limits/catch-up budgets or discard failed captures to pass.
Native all-tier robust flash delivery/registration, selected-star lighting authoring/control, residual smoke strand regularity/broad asymmetric haze and default art adoption.
Ordinary whole-host pacing/tail latency and production finale remain open; image lane is not cost proof.
